items.title: Zenith Launcher preview
items.body: The first Zenith launcher build can install Minecraft 1.21.1 with Fabric, set up the Zenith performance stack (Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore) and launch the game with the Zenith in-game client.

items.title: In-game client: press Right Shift
items.body: Open the Zenith menu in-game with Right Shift. HUD modules, toggle sprint, zoom, fullbright and more can be configured live, and /zenith commands are handled locally.
